_example._help: Entries in "sites" tell the TV how to read one index page. Only host and item are required; everything else is optional and falls back to automatic reading. All selectors are CSS selectors. "item" matches every event row; the others are looked up INSIDE each row, except "section" (headings of date groups, anywhere on the page: the nearest one above the row is used). "host" also matches its subdomains. Copy this object into "sites" and fill it in.
_example.title: h3.name
_example.subtitle: .organiser
